groups.why_chosen: Four primitive instructions manipulate a qubit token's position on the router tree: LOAD introduces it at the escape port, TRANSPORT slides it across an edge, ROUTE switches it between a router's own ports, and STORE commits it into a router's state.
groups.what_to_learn: an instruction-set catalog drawn as repeated before/after pairs of the same small structure, one pair per operation; a single highlighted sub-structure (green) plus a single moving token (orange) isolating what changed
